issue.title: test_acl.py should be skipped for PTF32 topology

failure.body:
**Description**
test_acl.py fails when run in PTF32 topology although the testcase says 'any' for topology support.
pytestmark = [
    pytest.mark.acl,
    pytest.mark.disable_loganalyzer,  # Disable automatic loganalyzer, since we use it for the test
    pytest.mark.topology("any"),
]

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run test_acl.py on ptf32 topology

**Describe the results you received:**
Test case fails because the ACL table that the testcase expects to create is never created.
Log analyzer expects 'Created ACL table' string to be present in syslog but it is not found because ACL table creation fails.
           # Cleanup Config DB if table creation failed
            logger.error("ACL table creation failed, attempting to clean-up...")
            create_or_remove_acl_table(duthost, acl_table_config, setup, "remove")
>           raise err
E           LogAnalyzerError: {'match_messages': {'/tmp/syslog.2022-04-28-<IPV6>': []}, 'total': {'expected_match': 0, 'expected_missing_match': 1, 'match': 0}, 'match_files': {'/tmp/syslog.2022-04-28-<IPV6>': {'expected_match': 0, 'match': 0}}, 'expect_messages': {'/tmp/syslog.2022-04-28-<IPV6>': []}, 'unused_expected_regexp': ['.*Created ACL table.*']}

acl/test_acl.py:321: LogAnalyzerError
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Captured log setup ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
INFO     root:__init__.py:49 Completeness level not set during test execution. Setting to default level: CompletenessLevel.basic
INFO     root:__init__.py:139 Test has no defined levels. Continue without test completeness checks
================================================================================================= warnings summary =================================================================================================
/usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/_pytest/config/__init__.py:538
  /usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/_pytest/config/__init__.py:538: PytestAssertRewriteWarning: Module already imported so cannot be rewritten: tests.common.dualtor
    self.import_plugin(import_spec)

-- Docs: https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/warnings.html
===================================================================================== 1 warnings, 736 error in 101.66 seconds ======================================================================================
Exception AttributeError: "'NoneType' object has no attribute 'close'" in <bound method EventDescriptor.__del__ of <ptf.ptfutils.EventDescriptor instance at 0x7fcd1ca47128>> ignored
**Describe the results you expected:**
Test case is expected to pass (or be skipped, not error or fail)

**Additional information you deem important:**
ACL Table creation fails because it is created with 'empty' port list and results in CLI failure.
From the testscript, the ACL table is created in the following way:
"config acl add table {} {} -s {} -p {}".format(
                    acl_table_config["table_name"],
                    acl_table_config["table_type"],
                    acl_table_config["table_stage"],
                    ",".join(setup["acl_table_ports"][namespace]),

And since 'acl_table_ports' is empty, there are no arguments after '-p' option to create the ACL table and hence the CLI command fails to create ACL table.

From reading the setup fixture, it is clear that acl_table_ports is populated only in the case of T0 or T1 topologies. In case of PTF32, it is populated using upstream_ports which is again filled in only for T0 or T1 topologies. For PTF32 topologies, there are no upstream ports.

Please confirm if this testcase is expected to be run on PTF32. And if not, please pytest mark the topology in the testcase as such.
